title: Republican politician angered by Argentina sheltering Nazis

tellings.quote: was a an American political, a Republican, very sort of a right-wing kind of guy, very conservative, but he got really angry when he found out that the Argentines were protecting Nazi war criminals.

plain: A researcher and author, Peter Levenda, tells of an American Republican politician, very conservative and right-wing by his account, who became furious after 1945 when he learned that Argentina was protecting Nazi war criminals. Levenda draws on his own books, including Secret Machines War and The Hitler Legacy, and links the story to his account of a German submarine said to have carried uranium to Japan. He tells it as part of a larger picture of Nazis escaping after the war with help from abroad.
